test_title: PYST 6: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 2 )
subject: english
question:
**In the given sentence, identify the segment which contains a grammatical error.**

While the night we felt afraid as the resort was very dark and secluded.
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: **While the night**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Replace** 'While' **with **'At'** to make the sentence correct, and '**the**' **should be omitted** because no specific night is mentioned in the given sentence.
 
• We usually use '**While**' when we have two continuous actions taking place at the same time.
 
 
• **Example -** *The phone rang **while **I was doing the dishes.*
 
 
 
• “**At**” is used when you are at the top, bottom or end of something; at a specific address; at a general location; and at a point.
 
 
• **Example -** Meet me at midnight.
 
 
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: "**We were terrified at night since the lodge was so remote and gloomy."**
 
• Therefore, '**at**' should be used because it is **referring **to a **night**.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 2**, which contains an error.

**Corrected sentence**: ***At night__ **we felt afraid as the resort was very dark and secluded.*
